title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause of failure. We show that poor acquisition and forgetting correlate linearly with the post-trained model's distribution shift, revealing the necessity of in-distribution learning. We thus introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), imitating SDFT's in-distribution rewrite by outsourcing the task to a minimally larger, same-family aligner. translated_title: 通过合成自蒸馏对小模型进行持续后训练
translated_abstract: 持续后训练面临获取与保持的双重挑战：模型必须在学习新能力的同时保留已有知识。虽然自蒸馏微调通过使用上下文示例的自我监督缓解了这一问题，但它依赖于强大的上下文学习和指令遵循能力。因此，SDFT 在对低延迟、端侧应用至关重要的小模型上会失效。为了在更小规模上实现持续学习，我们首先找出了失败的根本原因。我们证明了模型获取能力差和遗忘问题与后训练模型的分布偏移呈线性相关，这揭示了同分布学习的必要性。因此，我们提出了合成自蒸馏，通过将同分布重写任务外包给一个略大的同族对齐模型来模仿 SDFT 的做法。结合离线策略监督和拒绝采样，该方法提供了高质量的监督信号。
tldr: 该论文提出合成自蒸馏方法，通过让略大的同族对齐模型生成同分布的合成示范，并结合离线策略监督与拒绝采样，使缺乏强上下文学习能力的小模型也能在持续后训练中学习新能力的同时保留已有知识。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), which outsources in-distribution rewriting to a slightly larger same-family aligner, combined with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, enabling small models to continually acquire new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge.
